name: SEBinvest - Europa Hojt Udbytte AKL
summary: SEBinvest - Europa Højt Udbytte AKL is an open ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Investeringsforeningen SEBinvest. The fund invests in the public equity markets of Europe. It was formerly known as SEBinvest - Europa Hojt Udb. SEBinvest - Europa Højt Udbytte AKL is domiciled in Denmark.
